procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five page sheets are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2413x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/adams/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (14/14).
structure_note: Two logical tables over the county's 19 precincts, each split into a column-group pair with a TOTAL column only on its second page: p1 is the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A (columns: 11 precincts, then 8 precincts + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections (Senate, House D2, Court of Appeals 4 Position 2, Chancery 4 Places 1-3); p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the continuation of Chancery 4 Place 3 plus the two Circuit 6 sections. SEMS printed table B's row stream WITHOUT repeating table A's section headers beyond its own, so the section-continuation row that leads table B (Ashunda Hampton) prints under the precinct-header zone with no header box -- she is Debbra K. Halford's OPPONENT in Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 3 (the only contested chancery seat; identified against the independent press coverage of the race, and her countywide no-X cell pattern distinguishes her from Circuit 6-1's Carmen Brooks Drake whose row carries X in six of the eleven p4 columns). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty, sole candidate); Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 1 (E. Vincent Davis), Place 2 (Wayne Smith), Place 3 (Debbra K. Halford, Ashunda Hampton); Circuit Court 6-1-Circuit District 6-1 (Carmen Brooks Drake); Circuit Court 6-2-Circuit District 6-2 (Debra W. Blackwell). Printed totals: Colom 6277, Hyde-Smith 3462, Pinkins 134, Eller 3455, G. Thompson 6251, Foster 162, McCarty 6914, E. Vincent Davis 7798, Wayne Smith 6904, Halford 4547, Hampton 4252, Drake 2939, Blackwell 4859.
operator_rows_note: All 13 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry cells on both supply pages (p2: eleven precinct cells; p3: eight precinct cells + printed TOTAL). Hampton's row carries p4/p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. Drake's and Blackwell's rows print X position marks in the precinct columns outside Circuit Place 1's / Place 2's sub-district: only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL are supplied, and the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL (Drake 786+2153=2939; Blackwell 3776+1083=4859), the established X-cell rule both pages over.
truncation_note: No truncations; the nineteen precinct headers print complete ('Dist. 1, Belmont Precinct' ... 'Dist. 5, Washington Precinct'), internal commas kept verbatim and the trailing 'Precinct' stripped by precinct_norm like the county's 2024 files.
local_note: p4/p5 end with the local 'Adams-County Court Judge' section (WALT BROWN -- local, out of scope, and on an operator-supply page it contributes no parse rows). No other local sections print on this five-page sheet (no Election Commissioner / Coroner / School Board rows on pages 1-5) -- the sheet's row stream simply ends at County Court Judge. Circuit 6's two Places both print, so the family writes the Place-qualified labels 'Circuit Court Place 1'/'Circuit Court Place 2'; Chancery 4's three Places likewise ('Chancery Court Place 1/2/3'); CoA D4's single printed seat keeps the bare 'Court of Appeals' label.
